findings.reason: the section would send a node to delete a documented behaviour that neither its mechanism paragraph nor its measure preserves, and the deletion is silent because the measure cannot tell the two implementations apart.
findings.text: §10 states "The subscriber settles when the reading for every one of its populations says no live work" and measures that a subscriber "settles when the station's readings for all of its populations turn to no live work", which drops the grace `_check_settle` applies today: the current code settles only after the population has held nothing unfinished for `FOLLOWER_SETTLE_GRACE_SECONDS` (120 s, reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:285), because an admission handover leaves a session with no unfinished run while a queued request is adopted (crew_follow_commands.py:1519-1534, and the grace logic at :1553-1559). A node implementing §10's condition literally would end a pane on the first empty station reading and cut a pane off mid-handover, and the stated done-when passes for both the grace-keeping and the grace-dropping implementation

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every symbol §10 cites exists at the named module: `resumption.sweep` (reckon/crew/resumption.py:1768, both passes, review pass at :2034), `recovery_review_acceptance.dispatch_awaiting_reviews` (:377), `runs.sweep_unfollowed_sessions` (reckon/crew/runs.py:3746), `review_settle_seconds_remaining` and `_latest_resume_at` (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1258, :206), `REVIEW_SETTLE_SECONDS` (:889), `_check_settle`, `_population_has_live_work`, `FOLLOWER_SETTLE_SAMPLE_SECONDS` and `settle_populations` (reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1517, :482, :312, :1505), `dispatch_review_for_run` (recovery_review_dispatch.py:2462); extensionless hrefs resolve as `.html`.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §10's drain-settle measure states the settle condition without the grace `_check_settle` applies today (plan.html:317-321).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §10's measures are named test files under `tests/` and a trace of the deployed process; no gate log is routed to a scratch or node-local path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §10 introduces no plan label, stage name or ticket number into a symbol; the section reference to "old §81" stays in the plan document, which is where plan labels belong.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the added host rule matches the cited evidence: `sweep_unfollowed_sessions`'s docstring and its `_record_is_known_foreign` guard (reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:1145) state exactly the rationale §10 now gives ("a resume restarts a process on the host it runs on"), and `resumption.sweep` filters only by session (resumption.py:1815-1818), carrying no host rule of its own as the plan says. The section's other "today" claims re-verified: `review_settle_seconds_remaining` reads only `auto_resume` (:1266) while `_latest_resume_at` returns the newer of the two stamps (:206-224); the follower calls `sweep(project, session=session)` on its cadence (crew_follow_commands.py:1790); `_population_has_live_work` counts an ownerless pointer in every session's reading (crew_follow_commands.py:503-509), matching §10's ownerless rule; and the station caller §10 relies on exists (`reckon/crew/station.py`, launched as `crew station` from reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py:1898).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §10 has one deliverable, moving the sweep and settle detection into the station; the settle-reader change at :299-306 is a prerequisite its own advice-settle measure requires, not a second goal.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s10 declares depends-on s7 and s8 (plan.html:23), both the station process its measure traces and the settle-aware subscriber it measures, and s12 declares s10 as its upstream.
